night3_start.name: Me
night3_start.text: *I’m back in my room. It was a heavy day.*

night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.text: What you saw today, that’s a secret

night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.name: Me
night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.text: *‘You can come again.’ — For her, that’s the same as saying ‘please come.’*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.name: Me
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.text: *Yuna sent a photo of a note. A single line written in her notebook.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.text: That novel, I still haven’t decided on the ending

night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.text: If you’re gonna ask about my ankle, come ask in person lol

night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.name: Me
night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.text: *Masked with ‘haha’ — but the sincerity bleeds through.*

night3_dream_1.name: Me
night3_dream_1.text: *I had a dream. — I was walking side by side with someone.*

night3_dream_2.name: Me
night3_dream_2.text: *I couldn’t see their face, but just having them beside me put my heart at ease.*

night3_cheat_msg_1.name: Me
night3_cheat_msg_1.text: *I’m back in my room. It was a heavy day. I look at my phone.*

night3_cheat_msg_2.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_2.text: Only be that way with me

night3_cheat_msg_5.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_5.text: Who you’ll stand beside. I just want you to feel the weight of that

night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.text: ...lol I wish this were a joke

night3_cheat_msg_7.name: Me
night3_cheat_msg_7.text: *Yuna sent three messages. From someone who normally doesn’t even send one. — That’s how angry she is.*

night3_nightmare_2.name: Me
night3_nightmare_2.text: *I’m standing in darkness. I can’t see anything.*

night3_nightmare_3.name: Seoyeon
night3_nightmare_3.text: You promised. That it would only be me...

night3_nightmare_4.name: Yuna
night3_nightmare_4.text: I told you not to lie.

night3_nightmare_5.name: Dain
night3_nightmare_5.text: You said you’d come. I was waiting.

night3_nightmare_6.name: Me
night3_nightmare_6.text: *I see hands from three directions. Faintly, in the darkness.*

night3_nightmare_seo.name: Me
night3_nightmare_seo.text: *I reached toward Seoyeon. The moment I saw that smile — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_yuna.name: Me
night3_nightmare_yuna.text: *I stepped toward Yuna. Just as my fingertips were about to touch — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_dain.name: Me
night3_nightmare_dain.text: *I ran toward Dain. The moment I thought I had her — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_end.name: Me
night3_nightmare_end.text: *I reached out. — I can’t grasp it.*

night3_nightmare_end_3.name: Me
night3_nightmare_end_3.text: *— I woke up drenched in sweat. 3 AM. I see the ceiling.*

night3_cheat_reflect_1.name: Me
night3_cheat_reflect_1.text: *I pulled out my phone. Gallery. Scrolling again. — Sojeong's photo.*

night3_cheat_reflect_2.name: Me
night3_cheat_reflect_2.text: *She's smiling. Smiling at me in the group photo. Without knowing a thing.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3.name: Me
night3_cheat_reflect_3.text:
*At my old school, I couldn't say a word. To anyone. — This time, I wanted to say it without regrets.*

*But looking back now — I didn't really say it. I just threw it at everyone. That's not honesty — that's cowardice.*

night3_cheat_reflect_4.name: Me
night3_cheat_reflect_4.text:
*Old school: regret from saying nothing.*
*This school: regret from saying too much.*

*The exact opposite of what happened with Sojeong, but the result is the same. Someone gets hurt.*

*In the end, the problem was never 'to say or not to say' — it was 'to whom.'*

night3_cheat_reflect_5.name: Me
night3_cheat_reflect_5.text: *— I won't run. This time, just one person.*

night3_faithful_reflect_1.name: Me
night3_faithful_reflect_1.text: *I opened my eyes. Morning light seeps through the curtains. — Today's dream was a good one.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2.name: Me
night3_faithful_reflect_2.text:
*I pulled out my phone. Opened the gallery. Sojeong's photo. — I stopped scrolling, and held down.*

*'Delete this photo?'*

*— Deleted.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3.name: Me
night3_faithful_reflect_3.text: *I'd kept it because deleting it felt like erasing the regret. But now it's not regret anymore — it's a lesson. The photo that gave me the courage to confess. — It served its purpose.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4.name: Me
night3_faithful_reflect_4.text: *This time is different. I'll only speak to one person. The rest — I'll turn down properly. That's the only honest thing I can do.*
